description:
Self Financial is a venture-backed, high-growth FinTech company with a mission to increase economic inclusion and financial resilience by empowering people to build credit and build savings. 

 We're looking for people who share our passion and are driven to tackle challenges, find solutions and make the financial space better for the communities we serve. 

 Our team is passionate about challenging the status quo of the credit industry by providing people accessible tools to take control of their credit. Executing on our mission requires deep collaboration across our teams to ensure our products reach the people who can benefit from them the most, particularly the 100 million+ Americans who have no or low credit. 

 About the role 

 We’re growing our Frontend Engineering team at Self. As an Associate Frontend Software Engineer, you’ll help build Self Financial’s mobile app and web experiences while learning from experienced engineers on a high-performing team.

 This role is designed for someone early in their engineering career , typically with 0-3 years of professional experience. You’ll contribute to customer-facing features, improve your frontend fundamentals, and build high-quality software in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with frequent releases.

 We care deeply about creativity, quality, learning, and delivering an innovative user experience to a large customer base.

 What you’ll do 

 
 Build and maintain customer-facing features across Web, iOS, and Android with support from senior engineers.

 Implement frontend functionality using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS.

 Contribute to React Native mobile app experiences and web experiences as part of a cross-functional product team.

 Integrate frontend components with REST APIs and third-party services such as analytics, messaging, and feature flagging tools.

 Write clean, maintainable code and participate in code reviews.

 Learn and apply best practices for testing, accessibility, performance, and safe releases.

 Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend Engineering, QA, and your engineering manager to ship user-focused improvements.

 Debug issues, ask good questions, and grow your understanding of Self’s frontend architecture and development practices.

 Contribute to team rituals, documentation, and continuous improvement.

 
 What you bring 

 
 0-3 years of software engineering experience, including internships, co-ops, academic projects, bootcamp projects, or professional experience.

 Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern web development fundamentals.

 Basic understanding of REST APIs and how frontend applications communicate with backend services.

 Familiarity with Git and common software development workflows.

 Interest in writing reliable, tested, accessible, and maintainable code.

 Strong willingness to learn, receive feedback, and grow as part of a collaborative engineering team.

 
 What makes you stand out 

 
 Internship, project, or professional experience with React FrameworkExperience using agentic engineering tools (e.g., Claude, OpenAI/Codex, Copilot) to accelerate development workflows.

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

 Foundational experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.

 Experience building user interfaces with React, React Native, or similar frontend frameworks.

 Personal, academic, or open-source projects that demonstrate frontend craftsmanship and product thinking.

 
 Base salary range: $90,000-130,000 annually.  Individual pay and level is based on factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, experience, and other job-related reasons. 
 Benefits & Perks 

 
 Generous health, dental, and vision insurance coverage

 Employer-paid benefits including life, disability, and cost-containment resources

 Gym membership options through ClassPass or monthly reimbursement

 Education reimbursement program

 Paid parental leave

 Relocation bonus to move to Austin

 Referral program

 Company equity in the form of stock options

 Company performance-based bonuses

 Flexible vacation

 Hybrid work arrangement

 Casual dress code

 Team building events and activities

 ERG and inclusion opportunities

 
 Self Financial requires all employees hired to successfully pass a background check. 

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

 At this time, we are only able to consider applicants who are U.S. Citizens or Green Card Holders for employment opportunities. We appreciate your understanding.
